title: evidence.citation_audited (v1)
description: EvidenceAuditAgent has finished auditing the consolidated ResearchMemory for claims lacking citation support and frozen a CitationAuditReport into the Research Store (see agents/evidence_audit_agent/data-contracts/citation_audit_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the report is read from the Research Store by ref.

citation_audit_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen CitationAuditReport object.
